name: Tree Select
summary: A tree you pick a leaf from. The branches are disclosures, so the browser opens and closes them, and the leaf that is picked is a real radio, so the browser keeps exactly one of them picked.
summaryZh: 一棵可以从叶子里挑的树。分支是展开控件,所以开关由浏览器负责;被挑中的叶子是一个真正的单选框,所以浏览器保证组里恰好只有一个被选中。

variants.name: Plain
variants.note: The levels are held apart by indentation alone. The base class on its own is this layout, and the modifier paints the same thing so the class list can name it.

variants.name: With guides
variants.note: A rule runs down the side of each level, so the depth of a branch can be seen rather than counted.

sizes.name: Small
sizes.note: The text takes the caption size.

sizes.name: Medium
sizes.note: The default size. The base class is already this size, so it needs no modifier.

sizes.name: Large
sizes.note: The text takes the title size.

states.name: Open
states.note: The branch is open. The browser announces it, and the arrow turns over.

states.name: Checked
states.note: The picked leaf takes the brand colour's soft tint and its own text colour, and the circle next to it fills in.

states.name: Disabled
states.note: The leaf is inert. Its text takes the derived disabled colour and the circle dims, the way every other disabled control in the library dims.

states.name: Focus visible
states.note: The ring goes on the circle, because the circle is what the reader is on.

states.name: Show checkbox
states.note: The circle becomes the square the checkbox component draws, so a tree of boxes reads as boxes.

states.name: No arrow
states.note: The mark that says a branch holds something is not drawn, so a branch name stands where a leaf name stands.

states.name: Highlight current
states.note: The tree is told to mark the leaf the reader is on.

states.name: Accordion
states.note: Only the first open branch of a level shows what it holds, so the level reads as one branch at a time.

states.name: Auto expand parent
states.note: The branch the current one sits under shows what it holds, whether it is open or not.

states.name: Check strictly
states.note: Each mark stands on its own: a branch whose leaf is picked does not take the brand colour on its own mark.

states.name: Expand all
states.note: Every level of the tree is open, whether the branch says so or not.

states.name: Clearable
states.note: The field carries the mark that clears the choice.

states.name: Collapse tags
states.note: Only the first chip is shown, so the field keeps one line. How many were folded is the host's to say.

states.name: Filterable
states.note: The field carries the input the host filters the tree with.

states.name: Fit input width
states.note: The tree takes the width of the component it stands in rather than the width its own names ask for.

states.name: Dark effect
states.note: The component's own surface is filled with the brand colour.

states.name: Plain effect
states.note: The component's own surface drops the frame and the fill.

states.name: Loading
states.note: The data is on its way, so the tree says so instead of showing branches that are not there yet.

states.name: Tag in success
states.note: The chips take the success colour.

states.name: Tag in warning
states.note: The chips take the warning colour.

states.name: Tag in danger
states.note: The chips take the danger colour.

states.name: Tag in info
states.note: The chips take the neutral information colour.

states.name: Tag effect dark
states.note: The chips are a solid fill in the colour their type names.

states.name: Tag effect plain
states.note: The chips are an outline in the colour their type names, with no fill.

parts.name: Node
parts.note: One branch. It is a <details>, so it is the element that knows whether it is open.

parts.name: Option
parts.note: One row. It is the <summary> of a branch and the <label> of a leaf, and it is the element that can be asked whether its input is picked.

parts.name: Text
parts.note: The name of the thing the row holds.

parts.name: Arrow
parts.note: The mark that says the branch holds something. It is drawn from two borders, so it carries no text of its own, and it takes the room the circle takes on a leaf so that the names line up.

parts.name: Children
parts.note: The level below. It holds the rows inside this one, each of which is a leaf or a node of its own.

parts.name: Input
parts.note: The real radio. It is hidden visually rather than removed from the accessibility tree, so it keeps its place in the tab order and its name.

parts.name: Dot
parts.note: The circle drawn next to a leaf. The mark inside it is the same one the radio component draws, so a picked leaf looks like a picked radio.

parts.name: Field
parts.note: The row above the tree: it holds the prefix, the chips that show the choice, the filter and the clear mark. It takes no room when the host has asked for none of them.

parts.name: Prefix
parts.note: The mark that stands in front of the control. It is the host's own, so the library draws no glyph of its own.

parts.name: Tags
parts.note: The row of chips that shows the choice.

parts.name: Tag
parts.note: One chip. It holds one chosen value, and the type and the effect say how it is painted.

parts.name: Filter
parts.note: The input the host filters the tree with. It is a real search field, so the filtering is the host's script.

parts.name: Clear
parts.note: The mark that clears the choice. It is drawn from two bars, so it carries no text of its own, and it is a real button so the keyboard can reach it.

parts.name: Header
parts.note: What stands above the tree: a note, a heading.

parts.name: Footer
parts.note: What stands below the tree: a note, a count.

parts.name: Empty
parts.note: What the level below says when it holds nothing at all.

parts.name: Loading
parts.note: What the tree says while the data is on its way.

props.name: variant
props.description: How the levels are held apart. The plain run is the base class on its own; the guided run adds um-tree-select--lines.
props.descriptionZh: 各层之间怎么区分。无辅助线是只写基类;带辅助线再加上 um-tree-select--lines。

props.name: size
props.description: The size of the text in a row.
props.descriptionZh: 每一行文字的尺寸。

props.name: name
props.description: The name every leaf in the tree shares. It is the native name attribute, and it is what makes the leaves a group: the browser keeps exactly one of them picked.
props.descriptionZh: 树上所有叶子共用的名字。它是原生 name 属性,也正是它让这些叶子成为一组:浏览器保证组里恰好只有一个被选中。

props.name: value
props.description: The value one leaf submits while it is picked. It is also what the leaf says when the caller gives it no name of its own.
props.descriptionZh: 某个叶子选中时提交的值。调用方没有另外给名字的时候,它也是这个叶子显示的字。

props.name: label
props.description: The name of the thing the branch holds.
props.descriptionZh: 这一支里那个东西的名字。

props.name: checked
props.description: Picks the leaf. It is the native checked attribute, not a class.
props.descriptionZh: 选中这个叶子。它是原生 checked 属性,不是某个类。

props.name: disabled
props.description: Makes the leaf inert. It uses the real disabled attribute, so it leaves the tab order.
props.descriptionZh: 让这个叶子不可用。它用的是原生 disabled 属性,因此会退出 Tab 顺序。

props.name: model-value
props.description: The value the picked leaf submits, bound with v-model in Vue. Leave it out and the `value` prop is that value; bind it and the tree answers to the binding.
props.descriptionZh: 被选中的叶子的值,在 Vue 里用 v-model 绑定。不传就以 value 属性为准;传了就以绑定为准。

props.name: show-checkbox
props.description: Draws a box in front of every leaf instead of a circle, so a leaf reads as something that can be ticked rather than something that can be picked.
props.descriptionZh: 在每个叶子前面画一个方框而不是圆圈,于是叶子读起来像可以勾选的东西,而不是只能挑选的东西。

props.name: accordion
props.description: Whether only the first open branch of a level shows what it holds, so the level reads as one branch at a time. It adds um-tree-select--accordion.
props.descriptionZh: 同一层里是不是只有第一个展开的分支露出它的内容,于是这一层一次只像是一个分支。它加上 um-tree-select--accordion。

props.name: auto-expand-parent
props.description: Whether the branch the current one sits under shows what it holds, whether it is open or not. It adds um-tree-select--auto-expand-parent.
props.descriptionZh: 当前那一支的上一级是否露出它的内容,不管它自己是不是开着。它加上 um-tree-select--auto-expand-parent。

props.name: check-strictly
props.description: Whether each mark stands on its own, with no link drawn between a branch and the leaf under it. It adds um-tree-select--check-strictly.
props.descriptionZh: 每一个记号是不是各自独立,分支和它下面那个叶子之间不画关联。它加上 um-tree-select--check-strictly。

props.name: default-expand-all
props.description: Whether every level of the tree is open, whether the branch says so or not. It adds um-tree-select--default-expand-all.
props.descriptionZh: 树上的每一层是否都是展开的,不管那一支自己怎么说。它加上 um-tree-select--default-expand-all。

props.name: highlight-current
props.description: Whether the leaf the reader is on takes the highlight fill. It adds um-tree-select--highlight-current.
props.descriptionZh: 读者所在的那个叶子是否带上高亮底色。它加上 um-tree-select--highlight-current。

props.name: show-arrow
props.description: Whether the mark that says a branch holds something is drawn. Turning it off adds um-tree-select--no-arrow, the other way round from the other states, so the class always says what it does to the tree.
props.descriptionZh: 那个说明这一支里还有东西的记号画不画。关掉它加上 um-tree-select--no-arrow —— 和别的状态反着来,这样类名永远说明它对树做了什么。

props.name: clearable
props.description: Whether the field carries the mark that clears the choice. It adds um-tree-select--clearable.
props.descriptionZh: 输入区上是否带那个清空选择的记号。它加上 um-tree-select--clearable。

props.name: collapse-tags
props.description: Whether only the first chip is shown, so the field keeps one line. How many were folded is the host's to say. It adds um-tree-select--collapse-tags.
props.descriptionZh: 是不是只显示第一个标签,于是输入区只占一行。折叠了几个是宿主自己的事。它加上 um-tree-select--collapse-tags。

props.name: filterable
props.description: Whether the field carries the input the host filters the tree with. The input is a real search field, so the filtering is the host's script and the library only draws it. It adds um-tree-select--filterable.
props.descriptionZh: 输入区上是否带上那个供宿主筛选这棵树的输入框。这个输入框是真的搜索框,所以筛选是宿主脚本的事,库只负责画它。它加上 um-tree-select--filterable。

props.name: fit-input-width
props.description: Whether the tree takes the width of the component it stands in rather than the width its own names ask for. It adds um-tree-select--fit-input-width.
props.descriptionZh: 这棵树是否取所在容器的宽度,而不是由自己的名字撑出来的宽度。它加上 um-tree-select--fit-input-width。

props.name: effect
props.description: How the component's own surface is painted. The light effect is the surface the library draws, so it needs no modifier; the dark effect adds um-tree-select--effect-dark and the plain effect adds um-tree-select--effect-plain.
props.descriptionZh: 组件自己的底面怎么画。浅色效果就是库画的这个底面,不需要修饰类;深色效果加上 um-tree-select--effect-dark,朴素效果加上 um-tree-select--effect-plain。

props.name: loading
props.description: Whether the data is on its way, so the tree says so instead of showing branches that are not there yet. It adds um-tree-select--loading.
props.descriptionZh: 数据是不是还在路上,于是这棵树说明这件事,而不是显示还没到的分支。它加上 um-tree-select--loading。

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The hint in the filter field. It is the native placeholder attribute on the input, so the browser paints it in the muted placeholder role.
props.descriptionZh: 筛选输入框里的提示文字。它是 input 上的原生 placeholder 属性,所以浏览器会用弱化的占位文字色画它。

props.name: tag-type
props.description: Which colour the chips take. The primary colour is the one the library draws, so it needs no modifier; the other four add um-tree-select--tag-success, um-tree-select--tag-warning, um-tree-select--tag-danger and um-tree-select--tag-info.
props.descriptionZh: 标签取什么颜色。主色是库画的那个,不需要修饰类;另外四个分别加上 um-tree-select--tag-success、um-tree-select--tag-warning、um-tree-select--tag-danger 和 um-tree-select--tag-info。

props.name: tag-effect
props.description: How the chips are painted: a tint, a solid fill or an outline with no fill. The tint is the one the library draws, so it needs no modifier; the solid fill adds um-tree-select--tag-effect-dark and the outline adds um-tree-select--tag-effect-plain.
props.descriptionZh: 标签怎么画:淡底、实底,还是没有底色的描边。淡底是库画的那个,不需要修饰类;实底加上 um-tree-select--tag-effect-dark,描边加上 um-tree-select--tag-effect-plain。

slots.name: branch
slots.description: The name of the thing the branch holds.
slots.descriptionZh: 这一支里那个东西的名字。

slots.name: children
slots.description: The level below: one row per leaf inside this branch.
slots.descriptionZh: 下面那一层:这一支里的每个叶子放一行。

slots.name: default
slots.description: The name of the thing the branch holds. It is the name Element Plus gives the same content the label slot fills.
slots.descriptionZh: 这一支里那个东西的名字。它是 Element Plus 给 label 插槽所填的同一份内容起的名字。

slots.name: label
slots.description: The name of the thing the branch holds. It is the name Element Plus gives the same content the branch slot fills.
slots.descriptionZh: 这一支里那个东西的名字。它是 Element Plus 给 branch 插槽所填的同一份内容起的名字。

slots.name: prefix
slots.description: The mark that stands in front of the control. It is the host's own, so the library draws no glyph of its own.
slots.descriptionZh: 控件前面的记号。它是宿主自己的,所以库不画任何字形。

slots.name: tag
slots.description: What one chip says. It is given the chosen value and the chip's number. Without it the chip is empty, and an empty chip is not drawn.
slots.descriptionZh: 某一个标签写什么。它拿到选中的值和这个标签的序号。不给就空着,而空着的标签不画出来。

slots.name: header
slots.description: What stands above the tree: a note, a heading.
slots.descriptionZh: 树上面放什么:一句说明,或者一个小标题。

slots.name: footer
slots.description: What stands below the tree: a note, a count.
slots.descriptionZh: 树下面放什么:一句说明,或者一个计数。

slots.name: empty
slots.description: What the level below says when it holds nothing at all.
slots.descriptionZh: 下面那一层一个都没有的时候说什么。

slots.name: loading
slots.description: What the tree says while the data is on its way.
slots.descriptionZh: 数据还在路上的时候,这棵树说什么。

events.name: change
events.description: Fires when the picked leaf changes. It is the browser's own event on the input — the library installs no listener.
events.descriptionZh: 被选中的叶子换了一个时触发。这是 input 上的浏览器原生事件 —— 库没有安装任何监听器。

events.name: toggle
events.description: Fires when a branch opens or closes. It is the browser's own event on the details — the library installs no listener.
events.descriptionZh: 某一支展开或收起时触发。这是 details 上的浏览器原生事件 —— 库没有安装任何监听器。

events.name: check
events.description: Fires when the picked leaf changes, under the name Element Plus gives the same event.
events.descriptionZh: 被选中的叶子换了一个时触发,用的是 Element Plus 给同一个事件起的名字。

events.name: clear
events.description: Fires when the clear mark is pressed. The value that follows is the empty one, and the update:modelValue event carries it.
events.descriptionZh: 按下清空记号时触发。接下来的值是空值,update:modelValue 事件会带着它。

events.name: update:modelValue
events.description: Fires when the value changes, carrying the new value. This is the event `v-model` listens to.
events.descriptionZh: 值变化时触发,携带新的值。v-model 监听的就是这个事件。

a11y.notes: Every branch is a real <details> and every branch name is a real <summary>, so the browser announces each one as a disclosure button and says whether it is open. The leaves are real radios that share one name, so the browser keeps exactly one of them picked, the arrow keys move the pick inside the group and Tab moves between groups. The input is hidden visually rather than removed from the accessibility tree, so it keeps its place in the tab order and its label. The row knows it is picked because it holds the input: :has() is the only way CSS can ask an element what its child is doing.
a11y.notesZh: 每一支都是真正的 <details>,每一个分支名都是真正的 <summary>,所以浏览器会把它们各自播报成展开按钮,并说明它是开着还是关着。叶子是共用一个名字的真单选框,所以浏览器保证组里恰好只有一个被选中,方向键在组内移动选中项,Tab 在组与组之间移动。这个 input 只是视觉隐藏,没有被移出无障碍树,因此它仍在 Tab 顺序里,也仍然有标签。哪一行被选中,这一行知道,是因为 input 就在它里面:问元素「你孩子现在怎么样」,CSS 只有 :has() 这一种办法。

examples.title: A tree to pick from
examples.description: One branch, open, with a leaf under it. The leaf that is picked is a real radio, so the pick is the browser's and not a class. The levels are held apart by indentation alone.
examples.descriptionZh: 一支分支,开着,底下挂一个叶子。被挑中的叶子是一个真正的单选框,所以选中是浏览器做的事,不是某个类。各层只靠缩进区分。
examples.markup: Engineering

examples.title: With guides
examples.description: The same tree with a rule down the side of each level, so the depth of a branch can be seen rather than counted. Only the modifier class changes; the markup is the same.
examples.descriptionZh: 同一棵树,只是每一层旁边都有一道竖线,所以一支有多深是看得见的,不用数。只有那个修饰类变了,标记是同一份。
examples.markup: Engineering

notes: A branch is a disclosure and a leaf is a radio, and the two answer different questions: the disclosure says what is inside, the radio says what is chosen. The circle is drawn by this component rather than borrowed from the radio component, because a class the stylesheet does not declare paints nothing — and the drawn mark is the same one the radio draws, so the two look alike. The arrow takes the room the circle takes on a leaf, so a branch name and a leaf name start at the same place.
notesZh: 分支是展开控件,叶子是单选框,这两个回答的是不同的问题:展开控件说明里面有什么,单选框说明挑中了哪个。圆圈由这个组件自己画,不去借单选框组件的,因为样式表没有声明过的类画不出任何东西 —— 而画出来的那个记号跟单选框画的是同一个,所以两处看起来一样。箭头占的是叶子上圆圈占的那点位置,所以分支的名字和叶子的名字从同一条线开始。
